title: EAR-1 evaluation support
summary: Evaluate EAR-1 SD/DER and Mandarin SA-ASR/cpCER submissions. Submission conversion and the required text normalization feed the organizer scorer, which writes report.json.
limitations: Uses v1 nodes and the openbench-integration-0.1 scorer. Install SciPy and provide sessions.json with track D1 or R1. DER uses collar 0 and pools sessions; character-level cpCER is not comparable with cpWER.
